title: Global Excellence Scholarship Application 2026
mainQuestion: What are the exact eligibility criteria, deadlines, and renewal terms?
researchObjective: Verify if I qualify, confirm submission deadline, and ensure I can renew it for all four years without conflicting with other financial aid.
optionalContext: Applying for undergraduate engineering funding. Found two articles online and one student forum comment with differing dates.

sources.title: Ministry of Higher Education — Scholarship Circular (2025 Cycle)
sources.content: Official Announcement: Global Excellence Undergraduate Scholarship (Cycle 2025). Eligibility criteria require applicants to have achieved a minimum cumulative GPA of 3.8 on a 4.0 scale and be under 22 years of age at the time of enrollment. The final application submission deadline is 15 December at 11:59 PM EST. Required documents include certified academic transcripts, two letters of recommendation from faculty, an authenticated birth certificate, and a personal statement of purpose. Financial benefits include a 100% tuition fee waiver and an annual textbook stipend of $2,000 paid directly to the university account. The selection procedure consists of a preliminary document screening followed by an in-person panel interview in January.

sources.title: Global Scholars Hub — Complete Guide & Deadlines (2026 Cycle Update)
sources.content: Updated 2026 Guide: Global Excellence Scholarship overview. According to the advisory board update, the final application submission deadline is 20 December at 11:59 PM EST for the 2026 intake cycle. Gross annual family income must not exceed $60,000 as proven by the most recent certified tax return. Mandatory required documents are certified academic transcripts, two letters of recommendation, and state-verified income documentation. Award stacking policy and whether this grant can be combined with university merit stipends remains unannounced by the ministry.

sources.title: Student Union Discussion Thread #4092: Renewal & Appeals
sources.content: User Note: Just a heads up for new awardees—someone in our cohort heard that renewal conditions require maintaining at least a 3.5 GPA every semester, but nobody has seen the official deed yet. Also, there is no mention anywhere of any appeal procedure if your application gets rejected, so do not count on re-evaluations.

questions.whyItMatters: Breaching a hidden return-home or government service bond leads to severe financial clawbacks.

truthClashes.conflictReason: Source A is the official government circular from the prior cycle stating Dec 15. Source B is a third-party guide referencing 2026 stating Dec 20. Neither should be assumed correct until official 2026 portal verification.
truthClashes.verificationAdvice: Do NOT wait until 20 December. Aim for 15 December to stay safe, and verify on the live portal registration page directly.

Confirm whether a post-graduation service bond or repayment clawback exists

Check if stacking with department or university grants is prohibited
Inquire if administrative re-evaluation exists for transcript errors
